about: In-memory trees for the structure-naming name-pair proposer: each case lists the files changed in the reviewed change, an optional profile, and the [rule, first, second] pairs expected (first and second as names; order within a pair is ignored).

cases.name: every rule proposes its pair when every file changed
only pairs with a name in a changed file
an owner exception on either name's file drops the pair
